originals.ko: 우리가 지난번에 서로 본 후로 무슨 일이 있었어?
originals.why: The Welsh has 'tro diwetha’' with no article. This seed teaches 지난번에 = 'y tro diwetha’', so a learner who hears 지난번에 will say 'ers i ni weld ein gilydd y tro diwetha’'. That gives two possible answers.

The Welsh reads most naturally as the fragment 'the last time they left together', which is the same relative structure as the seed. Also, 자기들끼리 ('among themselves') does not mean efo'i gilydd ('together').
